description: Authentication + authorization identity. Deliberately thin: it holds ONLY what the login path needs, so `findOne({email})` stays a tiny document read. All descriptive data lives in `profiles`.

_class.description: Type discriminator written by Spring Data MongoDB. Allowed so the Java backend can persist without disabling its default type mapper.

username.description: URL-safe public handle. Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens only. Drives /portfolio/:username.

email.description: Stored lowercased and trimmed. Unique login identifier.

passwordHash.description: BCrypt hash ONLY. The pattern makes it structurally impossible to insert a plaintext password. Compatible with Spring Security BCryptPasswordEncoder.

role.description: Coarse authorization role. Admin panel routes require ADMIN.

status.description: ACTIVE = may log in. SUSPENDED = blocked by admin, data retained. DELETED = soft-deleted, mirrors `deleted: true`.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag. Every read path must filter on `deleted: false`.

failedLoginAttempts.description: Counter for brute-force lockout. Reset to 0 on a successful login.

lockedUntil.description: When set and in the future, authentication must be rejected.
